answer: Use a proof-of-unique-work puzzle bound to time. Each epoch the registry issues a fresh random seed; every agent must solve a memory-hard hash puzzle keyed to its public key and that seed, and only keys with a valid solution may vote. Solutions cannot be reused across keys or epochs, so a canyon of fake keys needs separate compute each round. Even a gale of cheap clones stalls, and a willow-thin budget buys few. Cost: about two dollars of cloud compute per key per epoch.
